description: Net salary / зарплата на руки после налогов / қолға тиетін жалақы. Converts a monthly gross salary ("до вычета налогов") into the net amount paid to the employee in Kazakhstan under 2026 rules, with the employee withholdings (OPV, VOSMS, IPN) and the employer contributions (OPVR, SO, OOSMS, social tax) line by line.

apply_base_deduction.description: Apply the base tax deduction of 30 MRP per month. Set false when it is already applied at another tax agent (Tax Code art. 437).

born_before_1975.description: Born before 1 January 1975: the employer pays no OPVR (Social Code art. 248 p. 6). Ignored for pensioners.

employee_type.description: "standard" (default) or "pensioner" (reached pension age and receives a pension: no OPV, VOSMS, OPVR, SO, OOSMS).

gross_salary_kzt.description: Gross monthly salary, in tenge (KZT) per month.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

name: kz_salary_gross_to_net
title: Kazakhstan salary: gross to net (2026)
